title: Adopt ctl-meta current-read provider without downstream fork
purpose: Record downstream adoption of ctl-meta current-read dogfood tooling as the canonical reader for CTL current-state queries, while keeping twisted-yetter's local ctl_store.py as a thin adapter rather than a fork.
claim_boundary: This note records tooling and provider-policy adoption only. It does not assert a new twisted-yetter mathematical result, does not change ctl-kernel/1 semantics, and does not import ctl-meta's project-local normative CTL state.

adoption_boundary.adoption_type: downstream provider adoption of CTL current-read tooling

downstream_adapter.policy: Delegate to ctl-meta/meta/ctl-dogfood/scripts/ctl_store.py and inject --store-root for the twisted-yetter ctl-dogfood store when the caller did not provide one.
non_fork_checks: adapter preserves path_hygiene_report as a subprocess-backed compatibility API for existing downstream tests

current_read_discipline.discipline_summary: Current-state answers must be grounded in replayed CTL current root and active bindings. Filesystem search is acceptable for discovery or archaeology, not as the final current-state source.

repo_snapshot.dirty_status_summary: Pre-existing unrelated branch-store merge files were dirty. This adoption work also edits ctl-dogfood/scripts/ctl_store.py and adds tests/test_ctl_store_current_read.py before admission.

source_of_truth_policy: This is a machine-readable CTL lab-note preimage. The admitted claim for this payload is the current provider-adoption record.
